segments.ja333:1.1: Tadeva me tvaṃ vidito, vanamajjhe rathesabha;
segments.ja333:2.1: Name namantassa bhaje bhajantaṃ, kiccānukubbassa kareyya kiccaṃ;
segments.ja333:2.3: Nānatthakāmassa kareyya atthaṃ, asambhajantampi na sambhajeyya.
segments.ja333:3.1: Caje cajantaṃ vanathaṃ na kayirā, apetacittena na sambhajeyya;
segments.ja333:3.3: Dijo dumaṃ khīṇaphalanti [phalaṃva (ka. sī. syā. ka.), dukanipāte puṭabhattajātakena saṃsandetabbaṃ] ñatvā, aññaṃ samekkheyya mahā hi loko.
segments.ja333:4.1: So te karissāmi yathānubhāvaṃ, kataññutaṃ khattiye [khattiyo (syā. ka.)] pekkhamāno;
segments.ja333:4.3: Sabbañca te issariyaṃ dadāmi, yassicchasī tassa tuvaṃ dadāmīti.
